items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I remember telling Miles. I say, “I got this little guy from my hometown that plays trumpet, and his daddy is a boxer.” So that right there piqued his interest right away.

ctx.x: sometimes Jimmy would get up and say, “Whoa, wow, it’s just like . . . .” He really would slip right into that character.
Probably him more than anybody. Miles picked him to be him.
